7.text: Marvell shares fell sharply after its all-stock acquisition and election-driven AI spending concerns, despite rising guidance and strong AI networking demand. Analysts remain bullish, seeing the selloff as a misread, and the stock rebounded Friday; Broadcom is barely mentioned.

9.text: Anthropic filed for an IPO targeting up to $64.4 billion and a roughly $1 trillion valuation, alongside a $26 billion private placement from Google, Nvidia, Microsoft, AMD, Broadcom, Micron and TSMC. Broadcom is named as a placement backer and is tied to $161 billion in Anthropic lease deals.

6.text: Broadcom shares fell sharply—down about 19–22% in a month, including a 2% drop to $325.48 and a 9% single-day decline—despite record AI-driven revenue and strong earnings growth. Analysts call the stock undervalued, citing margin pressure and a $63 billion financing structure as investor concerns.

8.text: Broadcom is cited as a buy in the November 11 sell-off piece and the November 5 dip article, and one November 9 piece says its custom AI chips for OpenAI and Google could outperform in 2027 despite a weak year. Other articles focus on AMD, Nvidia, TSMC, ASML, Intel, Arista, and Okta, mentioning Broadcom only in passing.

14.text: Broadcom’s AI data center growth is being driven by surging demand for custom AI chips and networking gear, with analysts raising targets after strong results.

11.text: Pragmatic Semiconductor added Mercedes Johnson to its board, and HMG Strategy will host a Tennessee tech leadership summit on November 13. Traefik Labs expanded its partner ecosystem, making Traefik Hub available on four enterprise platforms; none of these articles mention Broadcom.

15.text: The articles cover valuation and outlook questions for AMD, Nvidia, Qualcomm, Intel, Texas Instruments, and Nutanix, with no concrete Broadcom developments reported. They bear on Broadcom only as peer valuation comparisons.

5.text: AMD fell 16% in a month despite gigawatt-scale AI deals with Anthropic, OpenAI, and Meta, raising questions about its 190x earnings multiple. Broadcom is not mentioned; the story bears on it only as a peer AI chip stock facing similar valuation scrutiny.
